description: gertie is an ai health companion that provides continuous care intelligence for users, insurers and health care providers.
problem_statement: Healthcare operates on sporadic touchpoints - 12-minute appointments every few months, occasional nurse calls, wearable data limited to vitals, and patient portals with near-zero engagement. But real health issues emerge between these appointments: symptoms that fluctuate daily, side effects from new medications, emotional stress and mood shifts, cognitive fog, fatigue, and early signs of deterioration. Insurers and care teams only see these problems after they escalate into avoidable claims or preventable ER visits. There is no system that captures the daily lived experience of patients in a structured, scalable, clinically useful way - creating a massive blind spot where early intervention could prevent expensive downstream outcomes.
